title: Freedom – The label.
category: Brand Strategy · Social Media · Creative Direction
intro: A fashion brand launch concept built from strategy to execution, exploring how a new label could create a distinctive identity, build community and turn its first digital presence into a brand experience.

sections.heading: THE BRIEF
sections.text: How do you launch a fashion label from zero and turn it into a recognisable digital brand? The challenge was to develop a launch strategy that would introduce Freedom, The Label while creating a clear identity, building anticipation and establishing a community around the brand from day one.

sections.heading: THE APPROACH
sections.text:
Strategy → Identity → Content → Launch

I approached the project as more than a social media launch. The goal was to create a coherent brand experience, connecting positioning, visual direction, content and community across every stage of the launch.

sections.heading: STRATEGY & EXECUTION
sections.text: The concept was translated into a multi-platform content ecosystem across Instagram, Pinterest and LinkedIn. Each channel had a different role, from building the visual world of the brand and inspiring discovery to communicating its story, values and positioning.

sections.heading: THE LAUNCH PLAN
sections.text:
The launch was structured in four phases, each designed to move the audience from curiosity to recognition and participation.

Phase 01 — Tease
Create curiosity without revealing the full brand.

Phase 02 — Reveal
Introduce the identity, story and visual universe.

Phase 03 — Connect
Build familiarity through storytelling, interaction and community-led content.

Phase 04 — Launch
Bring the full brand experience together and turn attention into action.

sections.heading: THE BIGGER PICTURE
sections.text: Freedom, The Label became an exercise in thinking beyond individual content pieces and designing the full journey behind a brand launch. From the initial strategy to the final rollout, every element was developed to work together, balancing creative direction with structure, consistency and execution.
